handoff: review#9: approve. The review#8 rework holds: the rerun guard ignores norn's runs/-only commits (checked on the branch), gh run cancel handles a hung run, nothing_to_cancel is handled, and SK3 and the schema docs match. Both axes ran fresh: every command the skills order is accepted in that state, every B item is traced, unit tier 1174 and typecheck are green, test#7 passed. Nothing blocking. Minor: the rerun guard ignores uncommitted edits; no rule for a gate decided but not yet applied; name story wait --until stuck after a cancel; the flake test reruns an agent step; a whitespace --reason is dropped outside a round start; SK3 omits mode edits and gh actions. Table in handoff.

findings.title: Rerun-at-check guard ignores uncommitted edits
findings.detail:
After run cancel, the cancelled implement session may leave uncommitted edits. The rerun then judges a dirty worktree, and a pass is reported as a flake. The spec (B15, B42) only says 'no commit in between', so the gap is in the spec too.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Also require a clean worktree (git -C <unit worktree> status --porcelain empty) or escalate.

findings.title: No rule for a gate already decided but not yet applied
findings.detail:
Right after approve or reject, --until gate returns at once until the next tick applies the receipt (wait.ts:82). A second approve is refused with already_recorded (human.ts:355).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say: after a decision, wait with --until step=<next> or treat already_recorded as wait.

findings.title: 'wait for story view to show it stuck' names no wait command
findings.detail:
No foreground wait is named, so an agent may invent a poll.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: norn story wait <story> --until stuck --timeout 5m.

findings.title: Plan D5 still names status --json `delegated`
findings.detail:
The field was renamed to delegated_counts (status.ts:68), but the Plan text still says `delegated`.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Update D5's wording.

findings.title: Flake rerun test reruns at an agent step, not a check
findings.detail:
The test proves cancel → stuck → rerun --step with --delegated. It does not prove a rerun at a check step.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Use a check step in the harness workflow.

findings.title: Whitespace-only --reason dropped silently outside a round start
findings.detail:
The raw opt.str check differs from the trimmed d.reason check at :234. So --reason '  ' on a slice or a story that has not started is dropped, not refused with not_a_round_start.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Check the raw value in editWorkflow.

findings.title: SK3 omits the non-delegated actions the skill allows
findings.detail:
The skill also runs story edit --auto|--manual, which cannot be delegated, and the gh run cancel, rerun and merge commands. SK3 says the supervisor 'acts only through norn's commands' and carves out only run cancel.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Name these exceptions in SK3.

findings.title: Partial term coverage and small extras
findings.detail:
Test A does not assert B44's rounds and PR state, B25's base-conflict escalation, B41's --manual pause or B38. B17's handed-over command keeps --delegated. The human-qa gate is not discussed. trace-view.ts:717 has a dangling colon on an empty reason. status.ts:87-88 duplicates a comment. load.ts:457 widens DELEGATED_KINDS to string[].
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Tidy these when the code is next touched.
